blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 2. Choose and prepare the injection site:
section_path: 2. Choose and prepare the injection site:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Choose an injection site (see Figure 3)
section_path: 2. Choose and prepare the injection site:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Yesintek is given by injection under the skin (subcutaneously).
section_path: 2. Choose and prepare the injection site:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Good places for the injection are the upper thigh or around the belly (abdomen) at least 5 cm away from the navel (belly button).
section_path: 2. Choose and prepare the injection site:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If possible, do not use areas of skin that show signs of psoriasis.
section_path: 2. Choose and prepare the injection site:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If someone will assist in giving you the injection, then he or she may also choose the upper arms as an injection site
section_path: 2. Choose and prepare the injection site:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.caption: Figure 3
section_path: 2. Choose and prepare the injection site:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: caption
blocks.text: Figure 3
section_path: 2. Choose and prepare the injection site:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: footnote
blocks.text: *Areas in blue are recommended injection sites.
section_path: 2. Choose and prepare the injection site:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Prepare the injection site
section_path: 2. Choose and prepare the injection site:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Wash your hands very well with soap and warm water. Do not touch face or hair after washing hands.
section_path: 2. Choose and prepare the injection site:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Wipe the injection site on the skin with an antiseptic wipe
section_path: 2. Choose and prepare the injection site:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not touch this area again before giving the injection.
section_path: 2. Choose and prepare the injection site:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: caption
blocks.text: Figure 2
section_path: 2. Choose and prepare the injection site:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Remove prefilled syringe tray from carton
section_path: 2. Choose and prepare the injection site:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Open the tray by peeling away the cover. Hold the Needle safety guard (as shown in the Figure 4) to remove the prefilled syringe from the tray
section_path: 2. Choose and prepare the injection site:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Hold the prefilled syringe with the covered needle pointing upward.
section_path: 2. Choose and prepare the injection site:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Remove the needle cover (see Figure 5):
section_path: 2. Choose and prepare the injection site:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: The needle cover should not be removed until you are ready to inject the dose
section_path: 2. Choose and prepare the injection site:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Pick up the pre-filled syringe, hold the body of the syringe with one hand
section_path: 2. Choose and prepare the injection site:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Pull the needle cover straight off and throw it away. Do not touch the plunger while you do this
section_path: 2. Choose and prepare the injection site:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: You may notice an air bubble in the pre-filled syringe or a drop of liquid at the end of the needle. These are both normal and do not need to be removed
section_path: 2. Choose and prepare the injection site:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not touch the needle or allow it to touch any surface
section_path: 2. Choose and prepare the injection site:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not use the pre-filled syringe if it is dropped without the needle cover in place. If this happens, please contact your doctor or pharmacist
section_path: 2. Choose and prepare the injection site:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: lnject the dose promptly after removing the needle cover.
section_path: 2. Choose and prepare the injection site:
blocks.speaker: label

section_path: 2. Choose and prepare the injection site:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Grasp Here

blocks.text: Figure 4

blocks.caption: Figure 5

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 4. lnject the dose
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Hold the pre-filled syringe with one hand between the middle and index fingers and place the thumb on top of the plunger head and use the other hand to gently pinch the cleaned skin between your thumb and index finger. Do not squeeze it tightly
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not pull back on the plunger at anytime
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: In a single and swift motion, insert the needle through the skin as far as it will go (see Figure 6)
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 5. After the injection:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Press an antiseptic wipe over the injection site for a few seconds after the injection.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: There may be a small amount of blood or liquid at the injection site. This is normal.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: caption
blocks.text: FIGURE 6
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Inject all of the medication by pushing in the plunger until the plunger head is completely between the needle guard wings (see Figure 7)
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: caption
blocks.text: FIGURE 7
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Needle guard wings
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: When the plunger is pushed as far as it will go, continue to keep the pressure on the plunger head, take out the needle and let go of the skin (see Figure 8)
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: caption
blocks.text: FIGURE 8
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Slowly take your thumb off the plunger head to allow the empty syringe to move up until the entire needle is covered by the needle guard, as shown by Figure 9:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: FIGURE9
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: You can press a cotton ball or gauze over the injection site and hold for 10 seconds.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not rub the skin at the injection site. You may cover the injection site with a small adhesive bandage, if necessary.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 6. Disposal:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Used syringes should be placed in a puncture-resistant container, like a sharps container (see Figure 10). Never re-use a syringe, for your safety and health and for the safety of others. Dispose of your sharps container according to your local regulations.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Antiseptic wipes and other supplies can be disposed of in your garbage.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 1. What Yesintek is and what it is used for
section_path: 1. What Yesintek is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: What Yesintek is
section_path: 1. What Yesintek is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Yesintek contains the active substance 'ustekinumab', a monoclonal antibody. Monoclonal antibodies are proteins that recognise and bind specifically to certain proteins in the body.
section_path: 1. What Yesintek is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Yesintek belongs to a group of medicines called 'immunosuppressants'. These medicines work by weakening part of the immune system.
section_path: 1. What Yesintek is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: What Yesintek is used for
section_path: 1. What Yesintek is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Yesintek is used to treat the following inflammatory diseases:
section_path: 1. What Yesintek is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Plaque psoriasis - in adults
section_path: 1. What Yesintek is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Psoriatic arthritis - in adults
section_path: 1. What Yesintek is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Moderate to severe Crohn's disease - in adults
section_path: 1. What Yesintek is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Plaque psoriasis
section_path: 1. What Yesintek is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Plaque psoriasis is a skin condition that causes inflammation affecting the skin and nails. Yesintek will reduce the inflammation and other signs of the disease.
section_path: 1. What Yesintek is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Yesintek is used in adults with moderate to severe plaque psoriasis, who cannot use ciclosporin, methotrexate or phototherapy, or where these treatments did not work.
section_path: 1. What Yesintek is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Psoriatic arthritis
section_path: 1. What Yesintek is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Psoriatic arthritis is an inflammatory disease of the joints, usually accompanied by psoriasis. If you have active psoriatic arthritis you will first be given other medicines. If you do not respond well enough to these medicines, you may be given Yesintek to:
section_path: 1. What Yesintek is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Reduce the signs and symptoms of your disease.
section_path: 1. What Yesintek is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Improve your physical function.
section_path: 1. What Yesintek is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Slow down the damage to your joints.
section_path: 1. What Yesintek is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Crohn's disease
section_path: 1. What Yesintek is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Crohn's disease is an inflammatory disease of the bowel. If you have Crohn's disease you will first be given other medicines. If you do not respond well enough or are intolerant to these medicines, you may be given Yesintek to reduce the signs and symptoms of your disease.
section_path: 1. What Yesintek is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Do not use Yesintek
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you are allergic to ustekinumab or any of the other ingredients of this medicine (listed in section 6).
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you have an active infection which your doctor thinks is important.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you are not sure if any of the above applies to you, talk to your doctor or pharmacist before using Yesintek.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Warnings and precautions
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Talk to your doctor or pharmacist before using Yesintek. Your doctor will check how well you are before each treatment. Make sure you tell your doctor about any illness you have before each treatment. Also tell your doctor if you have recently been near anyone who might have tuberculosis. Your doctor will examine you and do a test for tuberculosis, before you have Yesintek. If your doctor thinks you are at risk of tuberculosis, you may be given medicines to treat it.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Look out for serious side effects
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
Look out for serious side effects
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Yesintek can cause serious side effects, including allergic reactions and infections. You must look out for certain signs of illness while you are taking Yesintek. See 'Serious side effects' in section 4 for a full list of these side effects.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
Look out for serious side effects
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Before you use Yesintek tell your doctor:
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
Before you use Yesintek tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you ever had an allergic reaction to Yesintek. Ask your doctor if you are not sure.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
Before you use Yesintek tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you have ever had any type of cancer - this is because immunosuppressants like Yesintek weaken part of the immune system. This may increase the risk of cancer.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
Before you use Yesintek tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you have been treated for psoriasis with other biologic medicines (a medicine produced from a biological source and usually given by injection) - the risk of cancer may be higher.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
Before you use Yesintek tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you have or have had a recent infection.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
Before you use Yesintek tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you have any new or changing lesions within psoriasis areas or on normal skin.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
Before you use Yesintek tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you are having any other treatment for psoriasis and/or psoriatic arthritis - such as another immunosuppressant or phototherapy (when your body is treated with a type of ultraviolet (UV) light). These treatments may also weaken part of the immune system. Using these therapies together with Yesintek has not been studied. However, it is possible it may increase the chance of diseases related to a weaker immune system.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
Before you use Yesintek tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you are having or have ever had injections to treat allergies - it is not known if Yesintek may affect these.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
Before you use Yesintek tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you are 65 years of age or over - you may be more likely to get infections.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
Before you use Yesintek tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you are not sure if any of the above applies to you, talk to your doctor or pharmacist before using Yesintek.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
Before you use Yesintek tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Some patients have experienced lupus-like reactions including skin lupus or lupus-like syndrome during treatment with ustekinumab. Talk to your doctor right away if you experience a red, raised, scaly rash sometimes with a darker border, in areas of the skin that are exposed to the sun or with joint pains.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
Before you use Yesintek tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Heart attack and strokes
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Heart attack and strokes have been observed in a study in patients with psoriasis treated with ustekinumab. Your doctor will regularly check your risk factors for heart disease and stroke in order to ensure that they are appropriately treated. Seek medical attention right away if you develop chest pain, weakness or abnormal sensation on one side of your body, facial droop, or speech or visual abnormalities.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Children and adolescents
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: The Yesintek pre-filled pen is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age with psoriasis or Crohn's disease because it has not been studied in this age group. The pre-filled syringe or vial should be used instead for children 6 years of age and older and adolescents with psoriasis. The solution for infusion, pre-filled vial or syringe should be used instead for children weighing at least 40 kg with Crohn's disease.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Yesintek is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age with psoriatic arthritis or children with Crohn's disease who weigh less than 40 kg because it has not been studied in this age group.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Other medicines, vaccines and Yesintek
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Tell your doctor or pharmacist:
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you are taking, have recently taken or might take any other medicines.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you have recently had or are going to have a vaccination. Some types of vaccines (live vaccines) should not be given while using Yesintek.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you received Yesintek while pregnant, tell your baby's doctor about your Yesintek treatment before the baby receives any vaccine, including live vaccines, such as the BCG vaccine (used to prevent tuberculosis). Live vaccines are not recommended for your baby in the first twelve months after birth if you received Yesintek during the pregnancy unless your baby's doctor recommends otherwise.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Pregnancy and breast-feeding
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or are planning to have a baby, ask your doctor for advice before taking this medicine.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: A higher risk of birth defects has not been seen in babies exposed to Yesintek in the womb. However, there is limited experience with Yesintek in pregnant women. It is therefore preferable to avoid the use of Yesintek in pregnancy.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you are a woman of childbearing potential, you are advised to avoid becoming pregnant and must use adequate contraception while using Yesintek and for at least 15 weeks after the last Yesintek treatment.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Yesintek can pass across the placenta to the unborn baby. If you received Yesintek during your pregnancy, your baby may have a higher risk for getting an infection.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: It is important that you tell your baby's doctors and other health care professionals if you received Yesintek during your pregnancy before the baby receives any vaccine. Live vaccines such as the BCG vaccine (used to prevent tuberculosis) are not recommended for your baby in the first twelve months after birth if you received Yesintek during the pregnancy unless your baby's doctor recommends otherwise.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Ustekinumab may pass into breast milk in very small amounts. Talk to your doctor if you are breast-feeding or are planning to breast-feed. You and your doctor should decide if you should breast-feed or use Yesintek - do not do both.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Driving and using machines
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Yesintek has no or negligible influence on the ability to drive and use machines.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Yesintek contains Polysorbate 80 (E 433)
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: This medicine contains 0.02 mg of polysorbate 80 (E 433) in each 45 mg/0.5 mL pre-filled pen which is equivalent to 0.02 mg/0.5 mL (0.0003 mg/kg/day). Polysorbates may cause allergic reactions. Tell your doctor if you have any known allergies
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 3. How to use Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Yesintek is intended for use under the guidance and supervision of a doctor experienced in treating conditions for which Yesintek is intended.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Always use this medicine exactly as your doctor has told you. Check with your doctor if you are not sure. Talk to your doctor about when you will have your injections and follow-up appointments.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: How much Yesintek is given
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Your doctor will decide how much Yesintek you need to use and for how long.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Adults aged 18 years or older Psoriasis or Psoriatic Arthritis
section_path: Adults aged 18 years or older Psoriasis or Psoriatic Arthritis
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: The recommended starting dose is 45 mg Yesintek. Patients who weigh more than 100 kilograms (kg) may start on a dose of 90 mg instead of 45 mg.
section_path: Adults aged 18 years or older Psoriasis or Psoriatic Arthritis
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: After the starting dose, you will have the next dose 4 weeks later, and then every 12 weeks. The following doses are usually the same as the starting dose.
section_path: Adults aged 18 years or older Psoriasis or Psoriatic Arthritis
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Crohn's disease
section_path: Adults aged 18 years or older Psoriasis or Psoriatic Arthritis
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: During treatment, the first dose of approximately 6 mg/kg Yesintek will be given by your doctor through a drip in a vein in your arm (intravenous infusion). After the starting dose, you will receive the next dose of 90 mg Yesintek after 8 weeks, then every 12 weeks thereafter by an injection under the skin ('subcutaneously').
section_path: Adults aged 18 years or older Psoriasis or Psoriatic Arthritis
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: In some patients, after the first injection under the skin, 90 mg Yesintek may be given every 8 weeks. Your doctor will decide when you should receive your next dose.
section_path: Adults aged 18 years or older Psoriasis or Psoriatic Arthritis
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: How Yesintek is given
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Yesintek is given as an injection under the skin ('subcutaneously'). At the start of your treatment, medical or nursing staff may inject Yesintek.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: However, you and your doctor may decide that you may inject Yesintek yourself. In this case you will get training on how to inject Yesintek yourself.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: For instructions on how to inject Yesintek, see 'Instructions for use' at the end of this leaflet.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Talk to your doctor if you have any questions about giving yourself an injection.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: If you use more Yesintek than you should
section_path: If you use more Yesintek than you should
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you have used or been given too much Yesintek, talk to a doctor or pharmacist straight away. Always have the outer carton of the medicine with you, even if it is empty.
section_path: If you use more Yesintek than you should
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: If you forget to use Yesintek
section_path: If you forget to use Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you forget a dose, contact your doctor or pharmacist. Do not take a double dose to make up for a forgotten dose.
section_path: If you forget to use Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: If you stop using Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: It is not dangerous to stop using Yesintek. However, if you stop, your symptoms may come back. If you have any further questions on the use of this medicine, ask your doctor or pharmacist.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 4. Possible side effects
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Like all medicines, this medicine can cause side effects, although not everybody gets them.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Serious side effects
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Some patients may have serious side effects that may need urgent treatment.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Serious allergic reactions ('anaphylaxis') are rare in people taking ustekinumab (may affect up to 1 in 1000 people). Signs include:
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: difficulty breathing or swallowing
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: low blood pressure, which can cause dizziness or light-headedness
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: swelling of the face, lips, mouth or throat.
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Common signs of an allergic reaction include skin rash and hives (these may affect up to 1 in 100 people).
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: In rare cases, allergic lung reactions and lung inflammation have been reported in patients who receive ustekinumab. Tell your doctor right away if you develop symptoms such as cough, shortness of breath, and fever.
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you have a serious allergic reaction, your doctor may decide that you should not use Yesintek again.
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Infections of the nose or throat and common cold are common (may affect up to 1 in 10 people)
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Infections of the chest are uncommon (may affect up to 1 in 100 people)
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Inflammation of tissue under the skin ('cellulitis') is uncommon (may affect up to 1 in 100 people)
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Shingles (a type of painful rash with blisters) are uncommon (may affect up to 1 in 100 people)
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Yesintek may make you less able to fight infections. Some infections could become serious and may include infections caused by viruses, fungi, bacteria (including tuberculosis), or parasites, including infections that mainly occur in people with a weakened immune system (opportunistic infections). Opportunistic infections of the brain (encephalitis, meningitis), lungs, and eye have been reported in patients receiving treatment with ustekinumab.
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: You must look out for signs of infection while you are using Yesintek. These include:
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: fever, flu-like symptoms, night sweats, weight loss
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: feeling tired or short of breath; cough which will not go away
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: warm, red and painful skin, or a painful skin rash with blisters
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: burning when passing water
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: diarrhoea
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: visual disturbance or vision loss
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: headache, neck stiffness, light sensitivity, nausea or confusion.
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of these signs of infection. These may be signs of infections such as chest infections, or skin infections or shingles or opportunistic infections that could have serious complications. Tell your doctor if you have any kind of infection that will not go away or keeps coming back. Your doctor may decide that you should not use Yesintek until the infection goes away. Also tell your doctor if you have any open cuts or sores as they might get infected.
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Shedding of skin - increase in redness and shedding of skin over a larger area of the body may be symptoms of erythrodermic psoriasis or exfoliative dermatitis, which are serious skin conditions. You should tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of these signs.
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.text: Other side effects
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Diarrhoea
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Nausea
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.text: Vomiting
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Feeling dizzy
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Headache
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Itching ('pruritus')
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.text: Back, muscle or joint pain
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.text: Sinus infection

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Uncommon side effects (may affect up to 1 in 100 people):
section_path: Uncommon side effects (may affect up to 1 in 100 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Tooth infections
section_path: Uncommon side effects (may affect up to 1 in 100 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Vaginal yeast infection
section_path: Uncommon side effects (may affect up to 1 in 100 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Depression
section_path: Uncommon side effects (may affect up to 1 in 100 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Blocked or stuffy nose
section_path: Uncommon side effects (may affect up to 1 in 100 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Bleeding, bruising, hardness, swelling and itching where the injection is given
section_path: Uncommon side effects (may affect up to 1 in 100 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Feeling weak
section_path: Uncommon side effects (may affect up to 1 in 100 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Drooping eyelid and sagging muscles on one side of the face ('facial palsy' or 'Bell's palsy'), which is usually temporary
section_path: Uncommon side effects (may affect up to 1 in 100 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: A change in psoriasis with redness and new tiny, yellow or white skin blisters, sometimes accompanied by fever (pustular psoriasis)
section_path: Uncommon side effects (may affect up to 1 in 100 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Peeling of the skin (skin exfoliation)
section_path: Uncommon side effects (may affect up to 1 in 100 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Acne
section_path: Uncommon side effects (may affect up to 1 in 100 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Rare side effects (may affect up to 1 in 1 000 people):
section_path: Uncommon side effects (may affect up to 1 in 100 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Redness and shedding of skin over a larger area of the body, which may be itchy or painful (exfoliative dermatitis). Similar symptoms sometimes develop as a natural change in the type of psoriasis symptoms (erythrodermic psoriasis)
section_path: Uncommon side effects (may affect up to 1 in 100 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Inflammation of small blood vessels, which can lead to a skin rash with small red or purple bumps, fever or joint pain (vasculitis)
section_path: Uncommon side effects (may affect up to 1 in 100 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Very rare side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 000 people):
section_path: Very rare side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 000 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Blistering of the skin that may be red, itchy, and painful (Bullous pemphigoid).
section_path: Very rare side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 000 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Skin lupus or lupus-like syndrome (red, raised scaly rash on areas of the skin exposed to the sun possibly with joint pains).
section_path: Very rare side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 000 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Reporting of side effects
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you get any side effects, talk to your doctor or pharmacist. This includes any possible side effects not listed in this leaflet. You can also report side effects directly via the national reporting system listed in Appendix V. By reporting side effects you can help provide more information on the safety of this medicine.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 5. How to store Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Keep this medicine out of the sight and reach of children.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Store in a refrigerator (2°C-8°C). Do not freeze.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Keep the pre-filled pen in the outer carton in order to protect from light.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If needed, individual Yesintek pre-filled pens may also be stored at room temperature up to 30°C for a maximum single period of up to 30 days in the original carton in order to protect from light. Record the date when the pre-filled pen is first removed from the refrigerator and the discard date in the space provided on the outer carton. The discard date must not exceed the original expiry date printed on the carton. Once a pre-filled pen has been stored at room temperature (up to 30°C), it should not be returned to the refrigerator. Discard the pre-filled pen if not used within 30 days at room temperature storage or by the original expiry date, whichever is earlier.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not shake Yesintek pre-filled pens. Prolonged vigorous shaking may damage the medicine.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Do not use this medicine:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: After the expiry date which is stated on the label and the carton after 'EXP'. The expiry date refers to the last day of that month.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If the liquid is discoloured, cloudy or you can see other foreign particles floating in it (see section 6 'What Yesintek looks like and contents of the pack').
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you know, or think that it may have been exposed to extreme temperatures (such as
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: accidentally frozen or heated).
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If the product has been shaken vigorously.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Yesintek is for single use only. Any unused product remaining in the pre-filled pen should be thrown away. Do not throw away any medicines via wastewater or household waste. Ask your pharmacist how to throw away medicines you no longer use. These measures will help protect the environment.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: What Yesintek contains
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: The active substance is ustekinumab. Each pre-filled pen contains 45 mg ustekinumab in 0.5 mL.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: The other ingredients are L-histidine, L-histidine monohydrochloride monohydrate, polysorbate 80 (E 433), sucrose, sodium hydroxide (for pH adjustment), hydrochloric acid (for pH adjustment) and water for injections.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: What Yesintek looks like and contents of the pack
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
What Yesintek looks like and contents of the pack
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Yesintek is a clear, colorless to pale yellow solution for injection. It is supplied as a carton pack containing 1 single-dose, glass 1 mL pre-filled pen. Each pre-filled pen contains 45 mg ustekinumab in 0.5 mL of solution for injection.

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Instructions for use
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Yesintek (ustekinumab) injection, for subcutaneous use Pre-filled pen
section_path: Yesintek (ustekinumab) injection, for subcutaneous use Pre-filled pen
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Read this Instructions for Use each time you use the Yesintek pre-filled pen. There may be new information. This information does not take the place of talking to your healthcare provider about your medical condition or your treatment.
section_path: Yesintek (ustekinumab) injection, for subcutaneous use Pre-filled pen
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Important Information You Need to Know Before Injecting Yesintek
section_path: Important Information You Need to Know Before Injecting Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Yesintek is a prescription medicine that is injected under the skin (subcutaneous) from a singledose pre-filled pen.
section_path: Important Information You Need to Know Before Injecting Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not reuse the Yesintek pre-filled pen. Always use a new Yesintek pre-filled pen for each injection.
section_path: Important Information You Need to Know Before Injecting Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Your healthcare provider may decide that a caregiver can give you the injections at home. You and your caregiver should receive training on the right way to prepare and inject Yesintek before using it for the first time.
section_path: Important Information You Need to Know Before Injecting Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not inject yourself or someone else until your healthcare provider has shown you how to inject Yesintek the right way.
section_path: Important Information You Need to Know Before Injecting Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not use the Yesintek pre-filled pen if it is expired or damaged.
section_path: Important Information You Need to Know Before Injecting Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If your dose is 45 mg, you will receive one 45 mg pre-filled pen.
section_path: Important Information You Need to Know Before Injecting Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If your dose is 90 mg, you will receive two 45 mg pre-filled pens. If you receive two 45 mg prefilled pens for a 90 mg dose, you will need to give yourself two injections, one right after the other.
section_path: Important Information You Need to Know Before Injecting Yesintek
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Storage Information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Store the Yesintek pre-filled pen in the refrigerator between 36°F to 46°F (2°C to 8°C).
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Keep the Yesintek pre-filled pen in the original carton to protect it from light before use.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If needed, the Yesintek pre-filled pen can be stored at room temperature between 68°F to 77°F (20°C to 25°C) for up to 30 days.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not use the Yesintek pre-filled pen if it has been left out at room temperature for more than 30 days. Throw away (dispose of) the Yesintek pre-filled pen into a sharps disposal container. Refer to Step 15 for more information.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not freeze the Yesintek pre-filled pen.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not shake the Yesintek pre-filled pen.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Keep Yesintek and all medicines out of the reach of children.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 1. What Yesintek is
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Yesintek contains the active substance 'ustekinumab', a monoclonal antibody. Monoclonal antibodies are proteins that recognise and bind specifically to certain proteins in the body.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Yesintek belongs to a group of medicines called 'immunosuppressants'. These medicines work by weakening part of the immune system.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: What Yesintek is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Yesintek administered using the pre-filled pen is used to treat the following inflammatory diseases:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Plaque psoriasis - in adults
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Psoriatic arthritis - in adults
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Moderate to severe Crohn's disease - in adults
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Plaque psoriasis
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Plaque psoriasis is a skin condition that causes inflammation affecting the skin and nails. Yesintek will reduce the inflammation and other signs of the disease.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Yesintek is used in adults with moderate to severe plaque psoriasis, who cannot use ciclosporin, methotrexate or phototherapy, or where these treatments did not work.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Psoriatic arthritis
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Psoriatic arthritis is an inflammatory disease of the joints, usually accompanied by psoriasis. If you have active psoriatic arthritis you will first be given other medicines. If you do not respond well enough to these medicines, you may be given Yesintek to:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Reduce the signs and symptoms of your disease.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Improve your physical function.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Slow down the damage to your joints.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Crohn's disease
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Crohn's disease is an inflammatory disease of the bowel. If you have Crohn's disease you will first be given other medicines. If you do not respond well enough or are intolerant to these medicines, you may be given Yesintek to reduce the signs and symptoms of your disease.
blocks.speaker: label
